newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS MIXED ON KEY UNITS.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS MIXED ON KEY UNITS.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar closed weaker on the rand and European currencies on Monday but was quoted a cent firmer against the key U.S. unit on the back of last-minute selling by some banks, dealers said.
"The Zimbabwe dollar firmed marginally against the U.S. dollar. I think there was a bit of off-loading by one or two banks," one dealer commented.
"Trade on the international market was sort of subdued today," he added.
The Zimbabwe dollar ended the day at 11.1450/1550 against the U.S. currency, a one cent gain over last Friday's 11.1550/1650 closing levels.
It however slid against sterling to 18.2000/2200 from 18.1320/1590, tracking a softer U.S. dollar overseas and was quoted at 6.5900/6000 against the mark, down from 6.5875/5950.
It also finished easier on the rand at 2.4950/5050 compared to 2.4910/4945.
